title: Reading Drill — Measuring bird calls from balconies — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Measuring bird calls from balconies — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Brackenton began with reports of calls from traffic crossings masking quieter birds. The bird survey team had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using sound recordings and chose calls correctly identified as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a dawn recording window. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted nine weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded microphone height as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
